default.source_line: The list was published on 19 August 2026 and is attributed to a 2024 breach at an unrelated retailer.

steps.text: Change the password on this account
steps.detail: Pick something this account has never used before, and something no other account uses either.

steps.text: Change it anywhere you reused it
steps.detail: Start with email and banking. A leaked pair gets tried against those first.
A second factor makes a stolen password on its own worth very little.
Anything you do not recognise, end the session and tell us.

sparse.body: You have not done anything wrong, and nothing has happened to your account here. A password on this account turned up in a published list of stolen credentials gathered from other companies.
sparse.safe_text: Anything held here. No payment details were involved. We have not reviewed this account's sign-in history, so we are not going to tell you it is clean — check it yourself once the password is changed.
